title: Technique-conditioned procedure member with ATT&CK's software links, and combiner columns for the optional members
parent: docs/preregistration/attribution_behavior_text_2026-10-20.json (rejected: the member reached the combiner only through the RRF features and the refitted fusion created three false names) and the attribution diagnosis of 2026-10-20 (docs 21.3.19)
problem: Technique-id sets do not separate groups (the four set members put the truth first in 0-1 of 55 CTI-HAL reports); the procedure, how a technique was done and with which tool, is where groups differ. ATT&CK documents it per technique (5,035 group procedure sentences, 11,362 software procedure sentences of which 6,284 belong to single-user malware, 550 campaign sentences on ATT&CK 20.0) and links software to groups. No current member conditions text on the accepted technique or uses the software links beyond the plain software member.
member: apt_classifier/procedure_match.py: for each accepted technique and its supporting statements, the statements are compared (TF-IDF cosine over sentences, the behaviour member's index) only with the corpus sentences documented under that technique (family=parent: also its parent and sub-techniques, never siblings). Routes per group: (1) the group's or its campaign's own sentence, vote = cosine; (2) a software procedure sentence under the technique, vote = cosine x the software member's rarity weight normalised to [0, 1] (tools capped) x (1 + seen_bonus) when the report names that software, for every group ATT&CK links the software to; (3) the text-free link, named software documented for the accepted technique, vote = link_weight x rarity for every user group. A group's vote per technique is the best route; its case score the mean over the accepted techniques (mean, absent = 0) or its five best (top5), z-scored, plus an optional prominence prior; softmax over the groups reached. Learned-profile family, never an independent evidence family (attribution.NOT_INDEPENDENT_EVIDENCE); joins the ensemble only with PROCEDURE_MATCH_WEIGHT > 0; fold hiding through the text member's refit (held-out sentences and the removed actor leave the index, software records lose the removed actor from their user lists).
combiner: apt_classifier/combiner.py feature schema 3: every optional member (group_mlp, text_group, behavior_text, procedure_match) gets the per-member columns present / inv_rank / score_rel and the three regime interactions, zero when it does not vote, appended after the schema-2 columns so every existing artifact keeps loading on its own columns. The gate's combiner is refitted with the member voting (PROCEDURE_MATCH_WEIGHT=1.0 scripts/fit_attribution_combiner.py --seeds 11 23 37 --variants 5 --unknown-all --output data/models/combiner/attribution_combiner_procedure_match.json, a new lists cache), so for the first time an optional member's own vote is weighed by the combiner
knowledge_base: ATT&CK 20.0 (updated 2026-10-21; the 20.0 baselines are regenerated first and are the off arm)
selection_on_dev: scripts/fit_procedure_match.py: the vendor set (34 reports) and the ATT&CK campaigns (21 reports, 15 groups, each scored against a corpus hiding its near-copies) are run through the engine once (--extract: the head-on default pipeline on ATT&CK 20.0 gives the accepted techniques, their statements and the named software; actor and campaign names replaced as the benchmarks replace them), then the member alone is scored for min_similarity in {0.15, 0.3} x family in {exact, parent} x software_route in {off, on} x seen_bonus in {0, 1} x link_weight in {0, 1} x aggregate in {mean, top5}, 64 variants; the best MRR over the 55 reports (ties: top-1, then the simplest: exact, no software route, no bonus, no link, mean, larger floor) sets the PROCEDURE_MATCH_* defaults. The ensemble weight is 1.0 (no weight sweep). Nothing is read from the fold seeds, CTI-HAL or Elastic before the gate

gate.naming_gate: ATT&CK folds on two seeds not used for any design (73 and 79), member on (weight 1.0, the refitted combiner) against off (the 20.0 default) under the same code: top-1 not below the off arm by more than 2 cases per seed; 0 wrong names; the removed actors named by the on arm not more than by the off arm on the same seed (the 19.2 default named one itself on seed 67), and none of them an unrelated group (not a documented same-activity partner of the removed actor)
gate.real_reports: CTI-HAL anonymised (55) and Elastic strict (8 + 22 open set), once each, on the 20.0 baselines: the ensemble must not lose top-1 on either set, must keep 0 wrong names, and the open set must name nothing; the member alone is reported (top-1, top-3, MRR), with no bar of its own
gate.adoption: if every bar holds, PROCEDURE_MATCH_WEIGHT defaults to 1.0 with the new combiner as ATTRIBUTION_COMBINER_PATH (and the confidence labels are refitted to it); a wrong name, a new open-set name or a lost real-report top-1 keeps it at 0 and the result is documented

secondary: the member alone on CTI-HAL and Elastic, and per CTI-HAL group; the share of its votes by route (group, software, link); the ensemble's named correct and coverage
the 24 CTI-HAL reports without ATT&CK software: top-1 before and after
the combiner's weights on the member's own columns (schema 3) against its RRF weight, as the first measurement of an optional member weighed on its own
the behaviour-text member re-scored once under schema 3 (BEHAVIOR_TEXT_WEIGHT=1.0, its own combiner refit) for the record only, if time allows
caveats: the same ATT&CK corpus that cites CTI-HAL's vendor reports feeds this member (docs 21.3.16: 12 of 27 text hits rested on it), so CTI-HAL numbers are optimistic; the fresh fold seeds and Elastic are the clean checks. The head's technique output enters this member only through the accepted techniques (not their text), and the head was trained on ATT&CK 19.2 procedure sentences, so the folds remain contaminated for the head as documented in 21.3.18; the off arm carries the same contamination
cost: laptop only: extraction a few minutes, grid seconds, combiner refit about 2 h, two fold seeds about 1 h, real reports 15 min; no API credit
